name: Amaenbo ~Futago Mama to Ecchi na Natsuyasumi~
original_name: 甘艶母 ～双子ママとエッチな夏休み～
source:
Yuki has beautiful mother, Shizuru. Since she works full-time, Miina, her younger sister, takes care of him and Naoto, her own son. One day, Yuki receives a letter from a girl. When he talks about it during dinner, Miina says, "Are you in love with a girl? Who is she? Please tell me later!" Yuki says, "Well, OK...." He is always confused when Miina asks him about it.... Why...?

[From ErogeShop]
